mornings.message:
Work heat expected in Gurdaspur tomorrow, 22 August. Our rule shows it will feel like 40 °C for outdoor work. 7 of 10 forecasts agree.

Work early and late, rest and drink water often. If you must work in the sun, work 6-10 am and after 5 pm, shade every hour and water often.

Heatstroke signs: confusion, no sweating, fainting. Cool the person and call 108.

Not an official warning service; follow IMD. We never ask for money or OTP. Was this useful? 1 Yes / 2 No
